Rich people treat money as something you can create again.

Kevin Trudeau describes the limiting belief he says broke people hold: opportunity is finite, the chance has passed, and it takes money to make money.

Rich people, he says, see money as a renewable resource. Even if they lose it all today, they believe they can create more.

Which of those two beliefs sounds more familiar to you?
